title: Unpatched ERP server vulnerability
description: Critical CVE identified on production ERP application server; no patch applied yet
mitigation: Apply vendor patch in next maintenance window; deploy compensating WAF rule in the interim

title: Terminated employees retaining system access
description: Access review identified terminated users with active accounts on the finance ERP
mitigation: Automate deprovisioning trigger from HR system; complete manual review of current access list

title: Lack of MFA on remote VPN access
description: Remote access to internal network does not require multi-factor authentication
mitigation: Roll out MFA enforcement policy for all VPN users

title: Segregation of duties conflict in AP/Procurement
description: One user holds both AP Clerk and Purchasing Agent roles enabling end-to-end control of vendor payments
mitigation: Remove dual role assignment or add supervisor review compensating control

title: Outdated third-party vendor risk assessments
description: Several critical vendors have not been reassessed in over 18 months
mitigation: Schedule reassessment for all critical vendors on a 12-month cycle

title: No documented incident response runbook for ransomware
description: Organization lacks a tested runbook for a ransomware scenario
mitigation: Draft and tabletop-test a ransomware response runbook

title: Shared administrator credentials on legacy file server
description: A legacy file server uses a single shared admin account instead of individual accounts
mitigation: Migrate to individual admin accounts with logging enabled

title: Backup restoration not tested in over a year
description: Backup restoration procedure for the financial database has not been tested recently
mitigation: Perform and document a full restoration test

title: Sensitive data stored in unencrypted spreadsheets
description: Payroll data identified in unencrypted spreadsheets on a shared drive
mitigation: Move data to access-controlled system and encrypt existing files

title: No formal change management approval for four production changes
description: ITGC testing identified production changes implemented without documented approval
mitigation: Enforced approval gate in change ticketing system prior to implementation
